tool_input.new_string:
await page.goto(`${appOrigin}/register/add`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 20000 })
  await page.locator('input[placeholder="请输入统一社会信用代码"]').waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 15000 })
  await page.locator('[data-testid="registration-company-type-01"]').click()
  await page.locator('input[placeholder="请输入统一社会信用代码"]').fill('91320594T233400001')
  await page.locator('input[placeholder="请输入企业名称"]').fill('T2334-READONLY-PROBE')
  await page.locator('input[placeholder="请输入法定代表人"]').fill('E2E Probe')
  const idType = page.locator('input[placeholder="请选择法定代表人证件类型"]')
  await idType.click()
  await page.locator('.el-select-dropdown__item').filter({ hasText: '护照' }).last().click()
  await page.locator('input[placeholder="请输入法定代表人证件号码"]').fill('P0000001')
  await page.locator('input[placeholder="请输入验证码"]').fill('0000')
  state.anonymousSnapshot = await page.locator('[data-testid="registration-create-temp-account-button"]').evaluate(element => {
    const chain = []
    let vm = element.__vue__
    for (let depth = 0; vm && depth < 12; depth++, vm = vm.$parent) {
      if (typeof vm.isAnonymous === 'boolean') chain.push({ isAnonymous: vm.isAnonymous, tokenPresent: Boolean(vm.token) })
    }
    return {
      buttonText: (element.innerText || '').trim(),
      buttonType: element.getAttribute('type'),
      hasAdminToken: Boolean(window.sessionStorage.getItem('Admin-Token')),
      chain
    }
  })
  await page.locator('[data-testid="registration-create-temp-account-button"]').click()
  await page.waitForTimeout(2500)
  state.expiredMessageVisible = await page.getByText('登录状态已过期，请重新登录', { exact: true }).isVisible().catch(() => false)
  await context.close()
